summary: EA Sports BIG's arcade street-basketball series; NBA Street V3 is already represented in the Mario archive because of the GameCube Mario cameo version, so this block adds the remaining non-duplicate NBA Street entries.

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for the PS2 primary route.

primary.why: The first NBA Street launched on PlayStation 2 before the GameCube port; the PS2 version preserves the original City Circuit structure before the later GameCube version altered the Michael Jordan final-challenge placement.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 version on original hardware or PCSX2 with internal-resolution scaling; use GameCube only for comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release with City Circuit, NBA rosters, Street Legends, and Michael Jordan content.
